lasts: A one-off baby clip stops getting views in about a week. The same face, voice, and room can keep going.
steps: Make one baby face and save it. Do not start from a real child's photo.
Pick one room and keep it. A new set every episode looks like a new channel.
Write four lines only: a request, a pause, a complaint, a last line that flips the request.
Record those four lines in your own voice. Do not clone a real person's voice.
Turn the still into a talking clip. Caption every line in big type.
Turn on the synthetic-content label. The next episode uses the same baby and the same room.

stack.Face: Any image generator that keeps a character consistent from a reference
stack.Motion: Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, Hailuo 2.3, or Seedance 2.0. Pick one and check its free tier today
stack.Voice: Your own voice. If you use text-to-speech, use one whose licence allows monetised videos

prompts.label: 1. Script prompt
prompts.tool: Paste into ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude
prompts.text:
You write short comedy scripts for an original AI baby character named [NAME]. Setting: [ROOM, e.g. a small kitchen]. The baby speaks like a tired [adult type, e.g. shopkeeper, electrician, schoolteacher].

Write [3] episodes. Each episode has exactly four lines:
1. A request.
2. A reply from the adult that misses the point.
3. The baby's complaint.
4. A last line that flips the request.

Language: [Hinglish in Roman script / Hindi / English]. At most 14 words per line. No real people, no brand names, no jokes about a real child.

Output a table with columns: line number, speaker, spoken line, on-screen caption, a five-word shot note.

prompts.label: 2. Character sheet prompt
prompts.text: Character sheet of one original fictional baby, about one year old, round face, [HAIR], wearing [OUTFIT, e.g. a yellow kurta]. Three views: front, three-quarter, side. Plain light grey background, soft studio light, the same face in all three views, clear eyes, no text, no logo. Soft 3D animation look. This is an invented character, not a real child.

prompts.label: 3. Scene prompt
prompts.tool: Paste into your video tool, with the character sheet as the reference image
prompts.text: Static medium shot in [ROOM]. The baby [NAME] sits in [a high chair] and looks into the camera. The baby says: "[LINE]". Lips match the speech. A small head tilt on the last word. Soft daylight, no camera shake, 6 seconds. Keep the face identical to the reference image. No text on screen.

avoid: A real child's face, a copied voice, or another channel's exact story. Change the joke, the room, and the voice in every episode so YouTube does not read the channel as templated.
